name: Tramsheds Series Sunday 2022
information:
This is a **series competition** alonside [Tramsheds Series Saturday 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TramshedsSeriesSaturday2022). **You will be permitted to compete at ONLY ONE of the two competitions.** If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each day has a slightly different set of events.

There is a strict limit of ONE GUEST PER COMPETITOR.

![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)
